decisions.reason: The quote explicitly states that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses are 'characterized by accumulation of lysosomal material and dysregulation of autophagy.' The disease is the grammatical subject, and dysregulation of autophagy is presented as a characteristic feature/mechanism of the disease. This directly supports the has_mechanism relationship.

The quote directly states that a prospective study was conducted 'in NCL patients receiving oral trehalose,' explicitly documenting that trehalose was studied in NCL. The sentence clearly establishes that the authors conducted a clinical study investigating trehalose treatment in NCL patients, supporting the studied_in relationship.
